items.q: Old Man Allen's, hire old men like, uh, little Alvin Alcorn, you know him?

ctx.x: Oh, who was in Old Man Allen's brass band? I forgot to ask you that.
Old Man Allen's brass band? Mm-hmm. Well, he'd, Old Man Allen's, hire old men like, uh, little Alvin Alcorn, you know him? Mm-hmm. Huh?
